title: YTForge / Infra
description: Scrape-target health and the collector/Temporal self-metrics that are actually wired up in this stack. There is no node_exporter/postgres_exporter/redis_exporter/cAdvisor in deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml yet, so container CPU/memory and Postgres/Redis/MinIO/Qdrant-internal metrics are NOT available here — add those exporters (and matching scrape jobs in prometheus.yml) before treating this as full infra coverage.

panels.title: OTel Collector: metric points received vs exported
panels.description: otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points vs otelcol_exporter_sent_metric_points — a persistent gap between the two indicates the collector is dropping data (backpressure, exporter failures). Metric names per the upstream otelcol-contrib self-telemetry convention as of the last check; verify against a live /metrics scrape.

panels.title: Temporal server process uptime
panels.description: Confirms the temporal scrape job is actually reachable. Exact metric name unverified against a live server in this sandbox — see the note on the Pipeline Health dashboard's task-queue-backlog panel.
